1. **快捷控制面板由 `CONFIG_LVGL_APP_UI_DEMO` 控制。**

位置在：[ui_demo/Kconfig](/data/work/0713_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/lvgl_app/ui_demo/Kconfig:1)

```kconfig
menu "快捷控制面板 Demo"

config LVGL_APP_UI_DEMO
    bool "启用快捷控制面板业务模块"
    default y
```

它被 [lvgl_app/Kconfig](/data/work/0713_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/lvgl_app/Kconfig:17) source 进来，所以 `menuconfig` 里会显示中文。`menuconfig` 没有自动翻译，显示中文只是因为 Kconfig prompt 本身写的是中文。

编译上由 [Makefile](/data/work/0713_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/lvgl_app/Makefile:22) 控制：

```make
ifeq ($(CONFIG_LVGL_APP_UI_DEMO),y)
CSRCS += ui_demo.c
CSRCS += ui_demo_wifi.c
...
endif
```

2. **关闭 WiFi 后 `lvgl_app` 编译不过，是因为快捷控制面板里的 WiFi UI 代码无条件调用 WiFi 符号。**

问题点在：[ui_demo_wifi.c](/data/work/0713_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/lvgl_app/ui_demo/src/ui_demo_wifi.c:73)

```c
extern int fhost_get_scan_results(...);
extern int wifistart_main(...);
extern int wifiscan_main(...);
extern int wificonnect_main(...);
extern int wifistop_main(...);
```

这些符号依赖：

- WiFi 驱动：`CONFIG_AIC_WLAN_AIC8800D40L`
- WiFi 命令：`wifistart / wifiscan / wificonnect / wifistop`

如果你关掉：

```text
CONFIG_AIC_WLAN_AIC8800D40L
```

但还保留：

```text
CONFIG_LVGL_APP_UI_DEMO=y
```

那 `ui_demo_wifi.c` 还会被编译，链接时就找不到 WiFi 相关符号。

当前最简单能编过的关闭方式是同时关闭：

```text
# CONFIG_AIC_WIRELESS_LAN is not set
# CONFIG_AIC_WLAN_AIC8800D40L is not set
# CONFIG_LVGL_APP_UI_DEMO is not set
```

也就是在 `menuconfig` 里关掉：

- `AIC Chip Configuration -> Wireless Support -> AIC8800 WiFi driver`
- `AIC apps -> LVGL application shell -> 快捷控制面板 Demo -> 启用快捷控制面板业务模块`

如果你想 **保留快捷控制面板，但只禁用 WiFi 功能**，需要改代码：给 `ui_demo_wifi.c` 加 `#ifdef CONFIG_AIC_WLAN_AIC8800D40L`，WiFi 关闭时提供 stub，返回 “WiFi 未启用/不可用”。否则当前代码结构不支持单独关 WiFi。

 	default y

 	depends on LVGL_APP_UI_DEMO_THREE_COLUMN

 	help

+		City code used by the t.weather.itboy.net fallback weather API.
+		The default 101010100 is Beijing.
 
 config LVGL_APP_UI_DEMO_MOCK_WIRELESS_DATA

 	default y

 	help

+		and other features that are not wired to real services yet.
 
 config LVGL_APP_UI_DEMO_VERTICAL_SLIDERS
-	bool "启用亮度 / 音量竖向滑块控件"
+	bool "Enable vertical brightness and volume sliders"
 	default y

+		Enable the brightness and volume sliders in the right column.
+		The sliders update UI values; touch events do not reconfigure
+		low-level backlight or audio drivers directly.
 
 config LVGL_APP_UI_DEMO_STATUS_WIDGETS
-	bool "启用时间、温湿度展示模块"
+	bool "Enable time, temperature, and humidity widgets"
 	default y
 	depends on LVGL_APP_UI_DEMO_THREE_COLUMN
 	help
-		启用右侧固定栏中的时间、温度、湿度占位展示模块，并保留

+		Enable the time, temperature, and humidity widgets in the right
+		column, and keep the external data refresh interface.

ifeq ($(CONFIG_AIC_WIFI_CMD),y)

如果恢复成原来的：

```make
ifneq ($(CONFIG_AIC_WLAN_AIC8800D40L),)
```

text: 目前结论偏向“不要删字段逻辑”。NuttX 的 `FBIOGET_VIDEOINFO` 会通过这个函数拿 `fmt`，Linux-compatible fb ioctl 和图形栈都会根据它转换色深/可视信息；如果直接去掉，最多只是当前某条路径没踩到，接口信息会变不完整。
我确认到 `apps` 里也有不少程序会直接 `ioctl(FBIOGET_VIDEOINFO)` 后按 `vinfo.fmt` 分支，例如截图、camera、fb 示例等。所以这个映射函数不是完全没用，只是被封装在 `getvideoinfo()` 里。

text: 当前 `.config` 实际是 `CONFIG_AICFB_RGB565=y` / `CONFIG_AICFB_FORMAT=0x0e`，所以这里会返回 `FB_FMT_RGB16_565`。如果删掉并写死 RGB32，当前板子的 framebuffer 信息就会和真实格式不一致。

不建议直接移除。准确说：**这个 helper 函数本身可以内联掉，但这段“MPP 格式到 NuttX FB_FMT”的映射逻辑不能删。**

它现在的作用是给 `FBIOGET_VIDEOINFO` 返回正确的 `vinfo->fmt`：

[drv_fb.c](/data/work/0713_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/chips/artinchips/drv/display/drv_fb.c:145)

```c
vinfo->fmt = aicfb_get_fb_format();
```

这个字段上层会用，例如：
- NuttX framebuffer core 会根据 `vinfo.fmt` 填 Linux-compatible `fb_var_screeninfo` / `fb_fix_screeninfo`。
- `fbcapture` 会按 `vinfo.fmt` 判断是 RGB565/RGB24/RGB32。
- `nxcamera` 会按 `vinfo.fmt` 选择 RGB32 或 RGB565 转换路径。

而且当前配置其实是：

```text
CONFIG_AICFB_RGB565=y
CONFIG_AICFB_FORMAT=0x0e
```

所以这里应该返回 `FB_FMT_RGB16_565`。如果删掉后写死 `FB_FMT_RGB32`，当前板子的 framebuffer 信息就错了；如果不填 `vinfo->fmt`，那就是未初始化值。

可以做的精简是把函数内联成：

```c
vinfo->fmt = aicfb_get_fb_format();
```

这种保持不变，或者改成宏/静态表，但不要删除这个格式映射。编译器看到 `AICFB_FORMAT` 是配置常量，基本会把这个 switch 优化掉，运行时代价可以忽略。

不能直接用在 `vinfo->fmt` 上。

`0x0e if AICFB_RGB565` 里的 `0x0e` 是 ArtInChip MPP/DE 的格式值，也就是：

[mpp_types.h](/data/work/0713_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/chips/artinchips/include/uapi/mpp_types.h:76)

```c
MPP_FMT_RGB_565 = 0x0e
```

但 `vinfo->fmt` 要的是 NuttX framebuffer 的 `FB_FMT_*` 值：

[fb.h](/data/work/0713_vela/nuttx/include/nuttx/video/fb.h:70)

```c
#define FB_FMT_RGB16_565 11
```

也就是说：

```c
AICFB_FORMAT        = 0x0e  // 14, MPP_FMT_RGB_565
FB_FMT_RGB16_565    = 11    // NuttX framebuffer format
```

如果直接写：

```c
vinfo->fmt = AICFB_FORMAT;
```

当前 RGB565 会把 `vinfo->fmt` 填成 `14`。但在 NuttX 里 `14` 是：

```c
#define FB_FMT_RGBRLE4 14
```

上层会误认为 framebuffer 是 RLE4，不是 RGB565，`fbcapture`、`nxcamera`、fb ioctl 兼容信息都会错。

所以这个函数本质是“MPP 格式 -> NuttX FB 格式”的转换，逻辑不能删。最多可以换一种写法，比如在 Kconfig 里再定义一个 `AICFB_FB_FORMAT` 专门存 `FB_FMT_*` 数值，但映射关系还是要存在。

## My request for Codex:
现在已经commit了在推上去之前需要先reposync吗？

建议先同步，但不要盲目 `repo sync --force-sync`。

如果只是推当前这个项目，推荐流程是：

```bash
git status
git fetch origin
git rebase origin/<目标分支>
make -C ../nuttx -j$(nproc)
git push
```

如果你们团队要求用 `repo` 管理整套工程，可以在已 commit 后跑当前项目或全工程同步：

```bash
repo sync -c --no-tags
```

但注意：
- 不要加 `--force-sync`，容易丢本地状态。
- 如果 `repo sync` 后发生 rebase/conflict，解决后继续 rebase，再重新编译。
- 同步后最好再跑一次构建，因为远端代码可能影响你的改动。

所以结论：**推之前最好同步/变基一次，但优先用 `git fetch + rebase`；只有需要同步多仓依赖时再用 `repo sync`。**

config AIC_BT_BT8858A
    bool "BT8858A Bluetooth driver"
    default n
    select SERIAL
    help

        RTS/CTS is optional and controlled by AIC_BT_UART_HW_FLOWCTRL.

    bool "Power-cycle BT_ON when starting AIC8800 HCI"

    help
        Force BT_ON low/high during HCI start. Leave this disabled for the

        4: WiFi/BT combo test

menuconfig NETUTILS_NETINIT
	bool "Network initialization"
	default n
	depends on NET
	select NETUTILS_NETLIB
	---help---
		This option enables/disables all support for common network initialization.

if NETUTILS_NETINIT

config NETINIT_NETLOCAL
	bool "Local network initialization"
	default n
	---help---
		If this option is selected, then this logic will only initialize the local
		attributes of the network:  The MAC address if needed and any IP
		addresses as needed.  More importantly, it will not do the following:

		- It will not bring the network up.  That can be done later with the
		  an ifup() call.
		- It will not associate any wireless devices to an access point.
		- It will not attempt to obtain an IP address if DHCPC is selected.
		  This may be done later from the apps/system/dhcpc 'renew' command.
		- It will not start the NTPC daemon.  This may be done later from
		  the with the apps/system/ntpc 'ntpcstart' command.

		This option permits you to divide the network configuration into two
		parts:  The local configuration of the network device and the dynamic
		configuration of the device in the network.  This may be important in
		an environment when, for example, you need to manually scan for
		available access points and associate the wireless driver with an
		access point.

config NETINIT_THREAD
	bool "Network initialization thread"
	default n
	depends on !DISABLE_PTHREAD && !NETINIT_NETLOCAL
	---help---
		NuttX is brought up through a series of sequential initialization
		steps.  This includes networking. If the network is available on
		reset, then there is really no issue.  Negotiating the link will
		take only a second or so and the delay to application startup is
		normally acceptable.

		But if there is no network connected, then the start-up delay can
		be very long depending upon things like the particular PHY, driver
		timeout delay times and number of retries.  A failed negotiation
		can potentially take a very long time, perhaps as much as a
		minute... Long enough that you might think that the board would
		never come up!

		One solution is enabled by this option.  If NETINIT_THREAD
		is selected, the network bring-up will occur in parallel with
		the application on a separate thread.  In this case, the application
		will start immediately with the network becoming available some time
		later (if at all).  This thread will terminate once it successfully
		initializes the network.

		NOTES:  If no network is connected, the network bring-up will fail
		and the network initialization thread will simply exit.  There are
		no retries and no mechanism to know if the network initialization
		was successful.  Furthermore, there is currently no support for
		detecting loss of network connection.  Lots of things to do!

if NETINIT_THREAD

config NETINIT_MONITOR
	bool "Monitor link state"
	default n
	depends on ARCH_PHY_INTERRUPT && NETDEV_PHY_IOCTL && NET_UDP
	---help---
		By default the net initialization thread will bring-up the network
		then exit, freeing all of the resources that it required.  This is a
		good behavior for systems with limited memory.

CONFIG=nuttx/.config
unset_symbol() {
  sym="$1"
  if grep -Eq "^(CONFIG_${sym}=|# CONFIG_${sym} is not set)" "$CONFIG"; then
    perl -0pi -e "s/^CONFIG_${sym}=.*\$/# CONFIG_${sym} is not set/m; s/^# CONFIG_${sym} is not set\$/# CONFIG_${sym} is not set/m" "$CONFIG"
  else
    printf '\n# CONFIG_%s is not set\n' "$sym" >> "$CONFIG"
  fi
}
set_symbol_y() {
  sym="$1"
  if grep -Eq "^(CONFIG_${sym}=|# CONFIG_${sym} is not set)" "$CONFIG"; then
    perl -0pi -e "s/^CONFIG_${sym}=.*\$/CONFIG_${sym}=y/m; s/^# CONFIG_${sym} is not set\$/CONFIG_${sym}=y/m" "$CONFIG"
  else
    printf '\nCONFIG_%s=y\n' "$sym" >> "$CONFIG"

验证过了：关闭 WiFi 后 `lvgl_app` 可以编译通过。最终通过的命令是：

```bash
make -C nuttx clean

```

注意：只关 `CONFIG_AIC_WLAN_AIC8800D40L` 还不够，会留下蓝牙/网络残留依赖导致链接失败。需要一起关掉 AIC8800 combo 相关蓝牙和无线工具项。

建议关闭的相关宏：

```config
# CONFIG_AIC_WIRELESS_LAN is not set
# CONFIG_AIC_WLAN_AIC8800D40L is not set
# CONFIG_AIC_WIFI_CMD is not set
# CONFIG_LVGL_APP_UI_DEMO_WIFI_BACKEND is not set

# CONFIG_DRIVERS_WIRELESS is not set
# CONFIG_NETDEV_WIRELESS_IOCTL is not set
# CONFIG_WIRELESS_WAPI is not set
# CONFIG_WIRELESS_WAPI_CMDTOOL is not set

# CONFIG_AIC_BT_BT8858A is not set
# CONFIG_AIC_BT_CMD is not set
# CONFIG_BLUETOOTH is not set

CONFIG_NETDEV_LATEINIT=y
```

`CONFIG_NETDEV_LATEINIT=y` 是为了避免关闭 AIC8800 网卡驱动后，系统启动初始化阶段还去链接 `riscv_netinitialize()`。

## My request for Codex:
所以那个宏才是真正关闭wifi的？

真正关闭 AIC8800 WiFi 驱动的是：

```config
# CONFIG_AIC_WLAN_AIC8800D40L is not set
```

这个才是 WiFi driver 主开关。它在：

```text
Wireless Support -> AIC8800 WiFi driver
```

几个相关宏的含义：

```config
CONFIG_AIC_WIRELESS_LAN
```

只是 AIC wireless 父菜单/框架开关，不是具体 WiFi 驱动。

```config
CONFIG_AIC_WIFI_CMD
```

只是 `wifistart/wifiscan/wificonnect/wifistop` 命令工具，不是驱动本体。

```config
CONFIG_LVGL_APP_UI_DEMO_WIFI_BACKEND
```

只是快捷控制面板调用真实 WiFi 后端的开关，不是 WiFi 驱动本体。

所以你要“真正关闭 WiFi”，defconfig 里关键是删掉或改掉：

```config
CONFIG_AIC_WLAN_AIC8800D40L=y
```

然后跑 `olddefconfig`，它会把 AIC8800 子项、`AIC_WIFI_CMD`、`LVGL_APP_UI_DEMO_WIFI_BACKEND` 这些依赖项一起隐藏/清掉。

但要让整包编译通过，我测试时还需要处理残留的 combo 蓝牙/无线工具项，例如关掉 `CONFIG_AIC_BT_BT8858A`、`CONFIG_BLUETOOTH`，并打开 `CONFIG_NETDEV_LATEINIT=y`。

## My request for Codex:
 CONFIG_AIC_WIFI_CMD 这个宏是什么？不是关闭wifi的吗

不是。`CONFIG_AIC_WIFI_CMD` 不是关闭 WiFi 驱动的宏。

它的作用是控制 **WiFi 命令应用**，也就是类似这些命令入口：

```text
wifistart
wifiscan
wificonnect
wifistop
```

它属于 `app/wifi_cmd` 这一层，是“命令工具/应用层包装”，不是底层 WiFi 驱动。

真正关闭 AIC8800 WiFi 驱动的是：

```config
# CONFIG_AIC_WLAN_AIC8800D40L is not set
```

关系大概是：

```text
CONFIG_AIC_WLAN_AIC8800D40L
  -> AIC8800 WiFi 驱动主开关

CONFIG_AIC_WIFI_CMD
  -> WiFi 命令行工具开关

CONFIG_LVGL_APP_UI_DEMO_WIFI_BACKEND
  -> LVGL 快捷控制面板是否调用真实 WiFi 后端
```

所以：

```config
# CONFIG_AIC_WIFI_CMD is not set
```

最多是不编/不启用 WiFi 命令工具，不代表 WiFi 驱动没了。

要真正关 WiFi，看这个：

```config
# CONFIG_AIC_WLAN_AIC8800D40L is not set
```

测了。结论：**只关闭 `CONFIG_AIC_WLAN_AIC8800D40L`，LVGL 源码能编译到，但最终镜像链接失败，所以 LVGL 起不来。**

我临时只改了这个：

```config
# CONFIG_AIC_WLAN_AIC8800D40L is not set
```

`olddefconfig` 后，`CONFIG_AIC_WIFI_CMD` 和 `CONFIG_LVGL_APP_UI_DEMO_WIFI_BACKEND` 会因为依赖被自动隐藏掉，这部分是对的。

但还有残留项没关：

```config
CONFIG_AIC_BT_BT8858A=y
CONFIG_BLUETOOTH=y
CONFIG_DRIVERS_WIRELESS=y
CONFIG_WIRELESS_WAPI=y
# CONFIG_NETDEV_LATEINIT is not set
```

最终链接失败点是：

```text
undefined reference to `riscv_netinitialize'
undefined reference to `cm_data_new'
undefined reference to `bt_sal_cm_acl_connected_callback'
...
```

所以问题不在 LVGL 解耦本身，而是 **只关 WiFi 主驱动后，蓝牙/WAPI/网络初始化没有一起收干净**。

我已经把 `nuttx/.config` 恢复回测试前状态并 clean 了。
